lines: Added `/auto-mode-setup`: a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway and telemetry-disabled sessions
meaning: A built-in command drafts autoMode.environment entries (trusted repos, domains, workflow context) for the auto mode classifier from the project and recent sessions - the 'give the classifier awareness of our environment' systemic fix GEN-349 asks to evaluate; we have no autoMode block in settings.json.

lines: Improved auto mode with the server-side classifier: a conversation too long for the safety check is now compacted, instead of every checked tool call being denied
meaning: Removes one more cause of blanket auto-mode denials tracked by GEN-423.

lines: Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly before returning any results; they now return an error saying the search failed
meaning: Upstream fix for the 'failed search read as nothing found' risk GEN-297 guards against, for Grep and Glob.

lines: Added the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back
meaning: Native per-prompt/refusal telemetry; needs an OpenTelemetry collector we do not run, and GEN-953 already dropped its own pop-up counter (GEN-946).
GEN-892 is Blocked only until GEN-871's supervised run passes; once this run passes, propose To Do (yes/no on the digest).
